changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla path_steps: secuencia personalizada de temas de una inscripción con estado, motivo de inclusión e intentos. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría path_steps_audit y el trigger path_steps_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Personalized sequence of topics of an enrollment

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment the step belongs to

column.name: topic_id
column.remarks: Topic of the step

column.name: step_order
column.remarks: Position of the step in the personalized sequence

column.name: status
column.remarks: Step status: skipped, blocked, pending, in_progress, passed, attempts_exhausted or on_hold

column.name: inclusion_reason
column.remarks: Why the topic is in the path

column.name: diagnostic_level
column.remarks: Level of the learner in the topic from the diagnostic

column.name: attempts_used
column.remarks: Attempts already used

column.name: extra_attempts_granted
column.remarks: Extra attempts granted by the instructor

column.name: best_score
column.remarks: Best score obtained in the step

column.name: last_score
column.remarks: Score of the last attempt

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE path_steps ADD CONSTRAINT path_steps_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('skipped', 'blocked', 'pending', 'in_progress', 'passed', 'attempts_exhausted', 'on_hold'))

ALTER TABLE path_steps ADD CONSTRAINT path_steps_inclusion_reason_ck CHECK (inclusion_reason IS NULL OR inclusion_reason IN ('skipped_mastered', 'weak_prerequisite', 'objective_focus', 'required_by_path', 'mandatory', 'fixed_path'))
ALTER TABLE path_steps ADD CONSTRAINT path_steps_attempts_ck CHECK (attempts_used >= 0 AND extra_attempts_granted >= 0)
CREATE TRIGGER path_steps_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON path_steps FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in path_steps

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE path_steps_audit ADD CONSTRAINT path_steps_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER path_steps_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON path_steps FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS path_steps_audit_trg ON path_steps
